div.div:
Operational Failure Modes & Boundary Invariants:
• Orphaned Blob Storage Leak: If the message token is permanently lost or routed to an unmonitored DLQ, the 50MB payload remains in object storage forever. Mitigate via automated bucket lifecycle retention policies (e.g., delete unreferenced blobs after 7 days).
• Read-After-Write Consistency Race: If the object store exhibits eventual consistency, a fast consumer might attempt GET before the blob has fully replicated, receiving HTTP 404. Modern S3 and GCS guarantee strong read-after-write consistency.
• Integrity & Tamper Protection: Never rely solely on object URIs. The pointer message must carry a cryptographic hash (sha256_digest) computed at write time to guarantee payload immutability across the hydration boundary.
